data.body: Investigation: ROOT_CAUSE identified — _mutation_to_batch_dict extracts local_id from payload.get('local_id', '') but outbound create mutations store the local_id in mutation.target and provenance, not in payload. The batch dict gets local_id='' causing create_one to search JQL 'dso-id:' (empty) and create an issue without proper identity binding. The fix: _mutation_to_batch_dict should also check mutation.target when payload lacks local_id.
